producer.note: operator-directed same-day implementation; independent fresh-context audit still required before merge/deploy

defect: run_kanban_goal_loop blocked the task (sticky human-review state) when a goal-mode worker exhausted its per-worker turn budget with the mission still open. The r6 checkpoint/requeue machinery (B-004) existed one layer below but the goal loop never invoked it, so every overnight mission died at the first worker's turn cap and the operator became the scheduler.

changes.summary: run_kanban_goal_loop gains an injected yield_fn: at turn-budget exhaustion with the mission open it persists a durable continuation (outcome yielded_budget) instead of blocking; block_fn remains the fail-closed fallback when no yield path is injected or checkpoint persistence raises. New goal_max_continuations() reads HERMES_GOAL_MAX_CONTINUATIONS (default 24, floor 1) as the successor-chain ceiling.

_run_kanban_goal_loop_q wires yield_fn to the revision-6 B-004 machinery (agent.turn_finalizer._yield_kanban_task_checkpoint -> kanban_db.yield_task_for_continuation): rich-or-emergency checkpoint, atomic requeue as work_item_kind=continuation, same task id, dispatcher relaunch. Refuses (raising, so the loop blocks loudly) when continuation_count >= goal_max_continuations() -- bounded successor chain, 2026-08-07 token-burn class prevention.

Five behavioral tests: budget exhaustion yields exactly one continuation carrying the latest response; yield failure falls back to a loud block; legacy no-yield_fn callers keep the block; genuine completion never spawns a successor; continuation-ceiling env parsing with floor.
